checks.name: the first plot takes a tree by F on day 0; another plot is marked as soil and waits for tomorrow
waking into summer opens the spring recap: days, the tree planted and the photo taken; the journal lists it
a day later the second plot takes a tree, saved with its day
on a misty day the pond gives the mistfish; on a clear day the same roll does not
the day after rain shows a rainbow over the sea opposite the sun and its photo completes the task; a plain clear day does not
lanterns are refused by day, set at night with F, photographed at the stone and carried down the creek
six grown trees stand clear on their plots
the tour flies all seven stops with captions, turns to dusk at the tower, ends by itself or on any key, and leaves position and light as they were
